class: A saved attachment is missed because the file input resets
symptom: Waystar showed two identical copies of its tailored resume.
root_cause: Inventory upload ran before the later attachment snapshot guard. Saved attachments leave their file input empty, and upload state starts fresh on a resumed run.
why_tests_missed: Upload tests covered same-run repetition but not a fresh agent with an existing attachment, including an iframe.
fix: Check the listed attachment in the upload input's own frame before uploading and set observed resume state when found.
prevention: Verify committed subject identity and existing attachment evidence across resumed runs rather than counting keystrokes or empty input values.
